resources.string: To browse and load massive schematic files smoothly, we recommend granting the "All Files Access" permission.

1. Click the ⊕ button on the top right to open any .litematic file directly via the Storage Access Framework (SAF).
2. After granting "All Files Access", use the built-in fast file browser to open files up to 20 million blocks directly.
3. In 3D preview, use gestures to rotate, pan, and zoom. Use the top controls to switch camera modes, reset view, or select rendering sub-regions.
4. Slide the bottom panel up/down to inspect detailed block statistics.

Lodestone Schematic Viewer

Built on top of the powerful @mattzh72/lodestone 3D Minecraft structure rendering engine. Providing offline 3D visualization and preview for large .litematic files.

Version: 1.0.0 (Release)
